title: 19-BCV-015 - Construction site fire safety plans
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE))

facts.text: The joint variance allows a building safety codes officer to accept construction/demolition site fire safety plans when fire safety codes officers are not readily available.
The fire safety plan requirements remain under NFC(AE) Section 5.6, including emergency procedures, site personnel duties, fire-hazard controls, and maintenance of firefighting measures.
Acceptance depends on the building safety codes officer’s designated powers and terms of employment; the document specifies eligible employing/accrediting bodies.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.

Historical status as of 2026-10-24: the official 2019 catalogue is marked archived/replaced by the 2023 catalogue; Alberta lists NBC(AE) 2019 as in force from 2019-12-01 through 2024-04-30. Alberta guidance says previous-edition STANDATA are obsolete for new construction after a new code takes effect, while remaining relevant to evaluation of existing structures during renovations and retrofits.
